issues.description: The current URL is /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-2, meaning the user is being redirected to authentication instead of landing on the step-2 room type selection page. The expected behavior describes room type selection with 6 buttons and style image grids, but instead the auth page is shown. The user is not authenticated, so the step-2 route is protected and redirecting to auth.
issues.element: Entire page — showing auth instead of step-2 room type selection
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-2 route has middleware or route-level auth protection that redirects unauthenticated users to /auth?next=/design/step-2. The middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts (or similar) is gating this route. This is likely intentional auth gating, but QA cannot reach the expected screen without an authenticated session.
